domains.title: Domains
domains.description: One per line, up to 1,000 per run. Domain names (example.com) or URLs (https://www.example.com/page): the domain is taken from the URL. For a subdomain (shop.example.com) the registered domain above it is looked up.

includeUnsupported.title: List domains on unsupported TLDs
includeUnsupported.description: Some country registries (for example .de, .io, .ch) have no RDAP service, and .uk is not supported. When on, those domains appear in the output with status "unsupported_tld" and are not charged. When off, they are left out.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The Actor normally works without a proxy.
